name: Kindlop
lore: Its ear tips glow brighter when it is happy. Families leave a lamp out so a Kindlop will stay the winter.
origin: Born in a lamp left burning through a long winter.

name: Smoldrake
lore: It cannot fly and never tries. Its smoke mane tells its mood: grey when calm, white when it means business.
origin: A Kindlop that kept the lighthouse fire for a whole season.

name: Calderox
lore: The cracks in its shoulder plates glow like banked coals. Herders warm their hands on a dozing Calderox in winter.
origin: Said to sleep inside the old kilns of the Thornridge.

name: Puddlet
lore: It is mostly water and a little stubbornness. After storms, dozens bob in the gutters, blowing bubbles at each other.
origin: A drop of the lighthouse lake that never wanted to sink.

name: Riptail
lore: It rides the current backwards just to show it can. Fishers say a Riptail in the weir means a good catch.
origin: Grows in the strong currents below the Saltmarsh dikes.

name: Leviarch
lore: The ring of light above it never touches the water. Old maps mark its lake with a single drawn circle.
origin: Old tales say it carries the lake's light down to the deep.

name: Mossling
lore: It hears rain coming with its long leaf ears and sits very still until the first drop. Gardeners welcome it: wherever it naps, seedlings follow.
origin: Sprouts where a Wayfarer once rested under a fern.

variants.lore: Under the Solenne sun its moss turns golden and smells of hay.

name: Thornback
lore: It rolls into a thorny ball when startled, then forgets why and rolls home.
origin: Its thorns grew to guard the young ferns of the Fernstair.

name: Verdantusk
lore: Ferns grow in its shaggy mane, and birds nest in its beard. An old one can graze for hours without moving a step.
origin: Walks the shaded edge of the forest where moss turns dark.

name: Zippit
lore: It stores static by scuttling across dry grass. Touching one in autumn makes your hair stand on end for an hour.
origin: A spark that jumped off the first storm over Brindlewick.

name: Glimmerax
lore: Its axe-shaped horn lights the way for night travellers. It is drawn to lanterns and to people humming.
origin: A Zippit that caught the lighthouse beam and kept it.

name: Shalebat
lore: Its wings are thin plates of slate that clatter in flight. Colonies sound like rain on a tin roof.
origin: Chipped off the Crowcrest cliffs on a cold night.

name: Obsidroth
lore: Slow, patient and very heavy. The glass shards on its back ring like bells when it laughs.
origin: Its stone hardened deep in the cliff, far from any light.

name: Zephlet
lore: It spreads its kite membrane and lets the wind push it along the ground. It has never once looked where it was going.
origin: A gust that got lost between the hills and stayed.

variants.lore: In Corvane its feathers soak up the rain and it glides low over the canals.

name: Tempestrel
lore: It rides storm winds over the peaks. Its crest crackles before a gale; shepherds watch it to know when to head home.
origin: Rides out every storm on the coast and returns unhurt.

variants.lore: Corvane storms gave it rain-grey wings that shed water like oil.

name: Wickit
lore: The little light on its crest never goes out, even under water. Miners once kept one in each tunnel as a friend.
origin: The last flicker of a candle that a child would not blow out.

variants.lore: Near the Ashmere furnaces its little flame burns orange instead of white.

name: Lumenewt
lore: Its gill stalks glow in slow waves, like breathing. Children follow the lights along the riverbank at dusk.
origin: Found where lamp light falls on still water.

variants.lore: It glows like a lamp in a glassworks and its skin feels warm as fresh glass.

name: Mirkmole
lore: It wears a hood of shadow against the sun. It is not afraid of the dark, only of being disturbed.
origin: Dug its way up from the dark under Murk Hollow.

name: Duskdigger
lore: It carries a slab of basalt on its back like a roof. Abandoned mines are often its doing, dug in a single night.
origin: Only a Mirkmole that saw Murk Hollow's dark grows like this.

name: Kelpup
lore: Its kelp fronds grow back when trimmed, so it loves a haircut. It barks at waves it doesn't like.
origin: Washed up in a knot of kelp after a high tide.

name: Kelphound
lore: Its mane streams out behind it when it swims, hiding it from bigger hunters. It guards fishing boats it has decided are its own.
origin: A Kelpup that found a pearl and grew around its glow.

name: Blotling
lore: It copies any line it sees onto the nearest wall. Wipe it off and the Blotling looks hurt.
origin: Crawled out of Mirela's old inkwells in the lighthouse.

name: Scrivane
lore: It draws maps of places it has never been. Wayfarers who followed them say the roads were right.
origin: A Blotling that read every page of Mirela's map book.

name: Hushkin
lore: It has no voice at all. When it is glad, the sign on its brow glows a little brighter.
origin: Born from the Hush itself, the silence that fell over Veydal.

name: Silentra
habitat: Ruins at the edge of Rifts
lore: It speaks only in floating signs of light. Those who learn to read them never feel alone again.
origin: A Hushkin that heard ten perfect echoes and answered in light.

name: Paddlewisp
lore: On stormy nights it pushes small boats gently back to the jetty, then spins away before anyone can thank it.
origin: Lives under Aldo's ferry and was born in its wake.

name: Ferrowyn
lore: Its sails catch every gust. Ferry crews leave a seat free at the bow in case it wants to ride along.
origin: A Paddlewisp that guided a ferry through a whole storm season.

name: Talusk
lore: If you trip over a Talusk it rolls together again and blinks at you, a little offended.
origin: A heap of Crowcrest scree that woke up with one grey eye.

variants.lore: Salt crystals grow on its tusks after a season by the Solenne lakes.

name: Talusgard
lore: It stacks one path stone on its back for every lost Wayfarer it has led home.
origin: A Talusk that carried its first waymark up the Crowcrest.

name: Cairnhold
lore: A beacon fire burns on its top stone. On dark nights it climbs the ridge so travellers can find the way.
origin: The oldest waymark of the Crowcrest, still walking.

name: Fluting
lore: The wind plays it like a flute. Lost walkers who follow the tune end up on the path home.
origin: A hollow reed of the Saltmarsh that learned the wind's songs.

name: Marshfife
lore: At dusk its song carries across the whole marsh, and the reeds bend toward it to listen.
origin: A Fluting that played through one long Saltmarsh dusk.

name: Glasstarn
lore: It only shows itself when there is no wind at all. Then it holds the whole sky on its back.
origin: A piece of a Crowcrest mountain lake that mirrors the sky.

name: Lanternel
lore: It follows the lighthouse beam as it sweeps the coast. Since the first storm it has never left Brindlewick.
origin: Followed the lighthouse lights to Brindlewick on the first storm night.

name: Seamlet
lore: It tries to sew the Rifts shut with threads of light. The threads never hold, so it keeps trying.
origin: A spark that jumped from the edge of a Rift.

name: Mendlace
lore: Where a Rift was mended, a Mendlace stays behind and checks the seam every night.
origin: A Seamlet that saw its own Rift mended at last.

name: Croziel
lore: It sleeps rolled up tight. In spring a whole slope of them uncurls at once.
origin: A young fern frond of the Fernstair that never stopped curling.

name: Frondmere
lore: Its antlers are open fern fronds. Each year it unrolls a new one.
origin: A Croziel that finally unrolled, frond by frond.

name: Brinelet
lore: Rain makes it shrink and sulk. A dry summer makes it grow almost a hand taller.
origin: A salt crystal from the pans of the Saltmarsh.

name: Saltspire
lore: After a dry summer it stands like a white pillar on the flats. Sailors use it to steer by.
origin: A Brinelet that grew through three dry summers.

name: Millwhit
lore: It rides the turning sails of old mills and squeaks once for every turn.
origin: Blown off a mill sail during the first spring storm of Corvane.

name: Millvane
lore: Its wings turn like sails. Millers say a good harvest follows it.
origin: A Millwhit that kept a broken mill turning through a whole rainy season.

name: Drizzlet
lore: It sleeps in rain barrels and wakes when the first drop falls.
origin: Fell from a raincloud that drifted too low over the delta.

name: Rainmantle
lore: Where it walks, a soft rain follows and the fields turn green.
origin: A Drizzlet that listened to the rain for a hundred nights.

name: Reedquill
lore: It writes little marks in the mud with its quill-like reed.
origin: Sprouted from a reed pen that a river clerk dropped.

name: Reedwarden
lore: It guards the river banks and mends broken dikes with reeds.
origin: A Reedquill that grew tall in the oldest reed bed of Corvane.

name: Cogmite
lore: It hums inside gear boxes and keeps the cogs from slipping.
origin: Found humming inside the oldest gear box of a river mill.

name: Cogwright
lore: It builds little wheels out of pebbles and sets them spinning.
origin: A Cogmite that learned every gear in a mill by heart.

name: Puddock
lore: It sits in puddles for hours and croaks when the water rises.
origin: Hatched in a flood field after the river broke its banks.

name: Delthorn
lore: Its back grows spines of river stone. It sleeps where three streams meet.
origin: A Puddock that sat out a whole flood on a single stone.

name: Glimmoth
lore: It circles the quay lamps and leaves a faint glow on everything it touches.
origin: Drawn out of the dark by the first lamp lit on the Corvane quays.

name: Wickmoth
lore: Its wings carry tiny lights. Boatmen follow it home in fog.
origin: A Glimmoth that guided a lost boat home through the fog.

name: Silthop
lore: It hops across silt banks and never sinks, however soft the mud.
origin: Shaped from river silt when the delta was still young.

name: Siltgrove
lore: Small trees grow on its back. Birds nest there in spring.
origin: A Silthop that slept so long on an island that it took root.

name: Flourie
lore: It puffs out clouds of flour dust and giggles when someone sneezes.
origin: Rose from a sack of flour on the day the first mill of Corvane opened.

name: Floursprite
lore: It drifts over the fields at harvest and shines like the morning.
origin: A Flourie that danced through a whole harvest festival.

name: Cindle
lore: It naps by the furnace doors and glows brighter when glass is blown.
origin: Born from a spark that leapt out of the first glass furnace of Ashmere.

name: Glassfell
lore: Its fur turns to warm glass at the tips and rings like a bell.
origin: A Cindle that slept inside a cooling glass furnace.

name: Etchling
lore: It scratches fine lines into copper and ink pools in its tracks.
origin: Scratched itself out of an old copperplate nobody could read.

name: Burinox
lore: Its horn is a sharp engraver's tool. It draws maps of places it has never seen.
origin: An Etchling that copied every plate in an Ashmere workshop.

name: Ashwren
lore: It bathes in warm ash and shakes it off in little grey clouds.
origin: Flew out of a chimney the night the moor fires went out.

name: Ashcrest
lore: Its crest glows like embers. It sings only when the moor is quiet.
origin: An Ashwren that sang until the ash moor grew green again.

name: Bogwick
lore: A small light flickers on its head. Travellers follow it and find dry paths.
origin: Grew from a peat lamp left burning at the edge of the bog.

name: Fenwarden
lore: It walks the bog at night and keeps the peat from burning.
origin: A Bogwick that guarded the bog through a long dry summer.

name: Cullet
lore: It is made of broken glass pieces that click softly when it walks.
origin: Gathered itself from the scrap heap behind a glassworks.

name: Cullhorn
lore: Its glass horn catches the sun and throws rainbows on the moor.
origin: A Cullet that was mended with gold by a kind glassmaker.

name: Smeltpup
lore: It chews on slag and its breath smells like hot metal.
origin: Pulled from a slag heap still warm from the smelter.

name: Smeltmaw
lore: Its jaw glows red. It melts rocks just by breathing on them.
origin: A Smeltpup that sat by the smelter fire for a whole winter.

name: Solkit
lore: It turns its face to the sun all day and glows softly at night.
origin: Woke in the first light that touched the Solenne plateau.

name: Solmantle
lore: Its mane holds sunlight. Shepherds warm their hands on it.
origin: A Solkit that watched a hundred sunrises from the highest stone.

name: Saltsprig
lore: Salt crystals grow on its leaves and sparkle in the sun.
origin: Sprouted where the salt lake dried for a single summer.

name: Saltcrown
lore: A crown of salt crystals rings its head. It hums by the lake at noon.
origin: A Saltsprig that drank from every salt lake of Solenne.

name: Orrlet
lore: Little rings orbit its body. It follows the stars across the dome.
origin: Fell out of a star map in the oldest observatory of Solenne.

name: Orrerine
lore: Its rings spin like a model of the sky. Astronomers set clocks by it.
origin: An Orrlet that counted every star in the plateau sky.

name: Duneshrew
lore: It burrows into hot sand and pops up far away.
origin: Dug its way up from under the oldest dune of the plateau.

name: Dunebastion
lore: Its shell is a dune of hard sand. Winds break on it like waves.
origin: A Duneshrew that held still through a whole sand storm.

name: Shimmerlet
habitat: Heat haze over the salt flats
lore: It hides in the shimmer of hot air. Only its shadow shows where it is.
origin: Rose out of the heat haze over the salt flats one bright noon.

name: Mirassil
habitat: Heat haze over the salt flats
lore: It shows travellers lakes that are not there, then leads them to real water.
origin: A Shimmerlet that led a lost caravan to water.

name: Highhare
lore: It leaps from ridge to ridge and lands without a sound.
origin: Born on the windiest ridge of the Solenne plateau.

name: Zenithare
lore: It runs so high on the ridges that it seems to touch the sky.
origin: A Highhare that raced the sunset along every ridge.

name: Velahra
habitat: Under the lake before the lighthouse
lore: The First Voice of Veydal. It sleeps as a light under the lake and sang the land together long ago. It was the last to see Mirela.
origin: One of the six First Voices, whose silence let the Hush fall over the land.

name: Hallowmur
habitat: The broken belfry of the Bellstone Ruins
lore: A bell that learned to listen. When the last ringer of the Bellstone left, the bell kept tolling by itself until it woke as Hallowmur.
origin: Woke from the last toll of the Bellstone bell.

name: Scriptorax
habitat: Between the shelves of the Wren Library, after closing
lore: Its wings are quills and its blood is ink. It writes down every route a Wayfarer walks, and crosses out the ones that were lies.
origin: Grew from the ink of the first map of Veydal.

name: Lumivane
habitat: The sunlit crown of the Sun Rift, once it is sealed
lore: A deer with a halo of horn and a lantern where its heart should be. Travellers lost in the dunes follow its glow home.
origin: Its heart was a lantern left at the Sun Rift by the first Wayfarer of Solenne.

name: Zephyrel
habitat: The wind above the Wide Rift's edge
lore: Four wings, no rest. It rides the updraft of the Wide Rift like a kite on a string nobody holds, and it has never touched the ground.
origin: A kite string snapped over the Wide Rift, and the wind kept the kite.

name: Monolurk
habitat: The cooled heart of the Kiln Rift
lore: A standing stone carved with runes nobody can read. When the Kiln Rift was sealed, the stone stood up and looked around.
origin: A rune stone from before the Rifts, baked hard in the Kiln Rift's heat.

name: Vorlucent
habitat: The dark beam of the Shade Rift, once it is sealed
lore: Its wings carry two eclipses. Where it lands, noon turns to dusk for a moment, and every lamp nearby flickers to greet it.
origin: Born in the shadow the Shade Rift cast at noon.

name: Rollib
lore: It rolls a ball of warm sand all day and sleeps curled around it at night.
origin: Hatched from a grain of sand that held the sun for a whole year.

name: Rollibex
lore: Its ball now glows at dusk. Travellers follow it to the next well.
origin: A Rollib that rolled its ball across the whole plateau and back.

name: Helirollax
lore: The ball on its back burns like a small sun. It pushes the morning over the dunes.
origin: The old towers say it rolled the first dawn up the sky.

name: Sirocub
lore: Its big ears catch the smallest breeze. It naps where the wind is coolest.
origin: Born in the first warm wind of a Solenne spring.

name: Sirocat
lore: It runs along dune crests so fast that the sand sings behind it.
origin: A Sirocub that raced a sandstorm and won.

name: Siroclaw
lore: When it flicks its ears, the hot wind turns. Caravans wait for its call.
origin: Grown in the eye of the great summer wind.

name: Scaldasp
lore: It basks on stones until it is too hot to touch, then hides in the shade.
origin: Slipped out of a crack in a sun-scorched rock.

name: Scaldcoil
lore: Its coils keep the noon heat long after sunset. Lizards sleep against it.
origin: A Scaldasp that slept a whole summer on the hottest rock.

name: Scaldrahn
lore: Heat shimmers above its horns. It guards the road between the oases.
origin: Grown where the sand road crosses the old lava field.

name: Noonpip
lore: It sings only at noon, when the shadows are shortest.
origin: Hatched on the top step of a sun tower.

name: Noonwhist
lore: A ring of light glows behind its head. Tower keepers use it as a clock.
origin: A Noonpip that sang through a hundred noons.

name: Noonsoral
lore: Its crest flares like the sun at its height. Its song carries across the plateau.
origin: The tower keepers say it is the noon itself, given feathers.

name: Spinnub
lore: It stores water in its round body and shares it with thirsty travellers.
origin: Sprouted from a seed buried under a waymarker stone.

name: Spinnarow
lore: A crown of blossoms opens on its head after the rare rain.
origin: A Spinnub that waited seven years for one rain.

name: Spinnacle
lore: It stands still for weeks like a stone tower. Birds nest safely among its spines.
origin: Grown on the highest slope of the cactus gardens.

name: Wadlet
lore: It sleeps in damp sand and wakes when a well fills up.
origin: Found in a dry riverbed after the first flood in years.

name: Wadishell
lore: Salt crystals grow on its shell. It carries water to dry pools.
origin: A Wadlet that crossed a salt flat to find a new pool.

name: Wadibastion
lore: Its shell is wide as a well cover. An oasis forms wherever it rests.
origin: The well diggers say the first oasis grew around one.

name: Ergfin
lore: It swims through loose sand as if it were water.
origin: Hatched in a dune that was once a lake.

name: Ergskim
lore: Its fins cut the sand so fast that it leaves a wake of dust.
origin: An Ergfin that swam the whole sand sea in one night.

name: Ergrava
lore: Whole dunes shift when it turns. Sailors of the sand sea greet it with a bell.
origin: Grown in the deep sand where the old lake bed lies.

name: Ardlet
lore: A small flame dances on its head. It keeps tower hearths warm at night.
origin: Sparked from the last ember of a tower beacon.

name: Ardlume
lore: Its flame turns white when it is proud. It hums while it warms the stones.
origin: An Ardlet that kept a beacon burning through a sandstorm.

name: Ardenthal
lore: Its crown of fire lights a whole tower. Wayfarers see it from a day away.
origin: Grown at the top of the oldest sun tower.

name: Fulgrit
lore: It licks the glassy sand where lightning struck and crackles happily.
origin: Born where a dry storm struck a dune.

name: Fulgorin
lore: The horn on its head draws sparks out of the dry air.
origin: A Fulgrit that stood in a storm and caught three bolts.

name: Fulgorath
lore: Its spines are tubes of lightning glass. When it roars, the sky answers.
origin: Grown on the glass fields after the great dry storm.

name: Carabun
lore: It walks beside caravans and never gets lost. Its hump holds water.
origin: Found asleep at a caravan stop, as if it had always been there.

name: Caravant
lore: It can walk ten days without a drink. Children play in the shade of its hump.
origin: A Carabun that led a lost caravan home.

name: Caravault
lore: Its hump holds a whole well. Towns grow along the roads it walks.
origin: The caravan folk say it walked the first road across Solenne.

name: Velvit
lore: It wakes at dusk and flutters around lamps until dawn.
origin: Hatched from a cocoon spun in a lamp shade.

name: Velvessa
lore: The eyes on its wings stare back at night hunters.
origin: A Velvit that stayed by one lamp for a whole season.

name: Velverain
lore: Its wings are soft as velvet and dark as the desert sky. Dust from them makes people dream.
origin: Grown under the starless sky of a new moon.

name: Clasplet
lore: It hides under stones in the heat and comes out to hunt beetles at night.
origin: Crawled out from under a fallen tower stone.

name: Claspirant
lore: It raises its tail as a warning long before it strikes.
origin: A Clasplet that guarded one stone for a hundred nights.

name: Claspreign
lore: Its claws can crack tower stone. Even sandstorms go around its den.
origin: Grown in the dark under the oldest ruin of Solenne.

name: Obelit
lore: It stands still on tower steps and is often taken for a small statue.
origin: Chipped off a sun tower when the first stone was laid.

name: Obelith
lore: The marks on its body glow in the order of the stars.
origin: An Obelit that stood one whole year in the sun.

name: Obelordan
lore: Its spire points at the sun all day. Its shadow tells the hour.
origin: The tower builders say they copied its shape.

name: Haboblet
lore: It curls up in dust devils and spins with them for fun.
origin: Whirled up out of a small dust devil.

name: Haboborn
lore: The sail on its back catches the storm. It rides the front of every sandstorm.
origin: A Haboblet that flew inside a storm for three days.

name: Habobrax
lore: When it raises its sail, a wall of sand rises behind it.
origin: Grown in the heart of the great sandstorm of the Tower Rift.

name: Stiltwade
lore: It stands on one leg in the salt shallows and never seems to tire.
origin: Hatched on a salt island in the middle of the lake.

name: Stiltregent
lore: Its long fan tail opens like a sunrise over the lake.
origin: A Stiltwade that led a flock across the salt lake.

name: Palmop
lore: Its leaves give shade to anything smaller than itself.
origin: Sprouted from a date stone dropped by a traveller.

name: Palmonarch
lore: Its fronds glow at dawn. Whole villages rest in its shade at noon.
origin: A Palmop that grew at the first well of Ochrewell.

name: Bakedil
lore: It sleeps in clay ovens after the bread is out. Its shell stays warm all night.
origin: Found in a cooling oven, curled up like a loaf.

name: Bakedillon
lore: The plates on its back are hot as baking stones. Bakers ask it for help.
origin: A Bakedil that warmed a whole village through a cold night.

name: Hazejel
lore: It floats in the noon haze and is hard to see unless you blink.
origin: Drifted out of a mirage that did not fade.

name: Hazejellith
lore: It shows travellers false lakes, then leads them to a real one.
origin: A Hazejel that drifted over the whole sand sea.

name: Corocub
lore: Its mane glows like embers. It pounces on its own shadow.
origin: Born on the hottest rock of the plateau at noon.

name: Coronarch
lore: Its mane blazes like the sun's corona. Its roar can be heard across the plateau.
origin: A Corocub that stared at the sun without blinking.

name: Chirrik
lore: It chirps in the dry grass from dawn to dusk.
origin: Hatched in a millet field after a hot summer.

name: Chirrikade
lore: One leap carries it over a house. Farmers welcome it, it eats only weeds.
origin: A Chirrik that jumped across a whole canyon.

name: Brinewhorl
lore: Its shell is crusted with salt. It writes slow spirals on the lake shore.
origin: Grew from a salt crystal that was never washed away.

name: Gyrevult
lore: It circles high over the canyon for hours without a single wing beat.
origin: Rose out of the canyon on the first thermal of the morning.

name: Heliodrop
lore: A drop of sunlight that fell and did not cool. It giggles when touched.
origin: Fell from the sky on the longest day of the year.

name: Duskmirrah
lore: It is seen only in the moment the sun sets. Half of it glows, half is shadow.
origin: Stepped out of the line between day and night.

name: Sootpaw
lore: It leaves black paw prints on every roof it crosses.
origin: Tumbled out of a chimney during the first winter fire.

name: Sootlurk
lore: It hides in ash heaps with only its glowing eyes showing.
origin: A Sootpaw that slept a whole winter in a cold chimney.

name: Sootharrow
lore: Its tail burns like a torch. Chimney sweeps tip their hats to it.
origin: Grown on the tallest chimney of Cinderfold.

name: Vitrill
lore: Its shell is clear glass. You can see its little heart glow inside.
origin: Formed from a drop of glass that fell from a blowpipe.

name: Vitrillon
lore: Glass crystals grow on its back. It rings like a bell when it bumps into things.
origin: A Vitrill that rested in a cooling oven for a night.

name: Vitrillaxe
lore: Its glass horn splits light into colours. The glassworks hang its shed shards in their windows.
origin: Grown in the oldest furnace of the glassworks.

name: Sablet
habitat: Dark rafters of the engravers' halls
lore: It watches the engravers at work and blinks slowly when they make a mistake.
origin: Hatched in the rafters of the engravers' hall.

name: Sablowl
habitat: Dark rafters of the engravers' halls
lore: Its feathers are soft as soot. It flies without a sound through the dark halls.
origin: A Sablet that stayed awake through a hundred night shifts.

name: Sablarch
habitat: Dark rafters of the engravers' halls
lore: Its wide eyes see every line in the dark. Engravers ask it to check their plates.
origin: Grown in the darkest corner of the Gravers' Hall.

name: Quenchet
lore: It hisses when it slides into water and leaves a trail of steam.
origin: Slipped out of a quench tank when hot iron was dipped in.

name: Quenchcoil
lore: Its fin sail cools in water and glows again in the air.
origin: A Quenchet that swam through every quench tank of the works.

name: Quenchwyrm
lore: Clouds of steam roll off its back. Smiths use its pools to harden their best blades.
origin: Grown in the great steaming pool under the kilns.

name: Brickit
lore: It stacks loose bricks into little towers and sits on top of them.
origin: Pressed into shape by mistake in a brick mould.

name: Brickwarden
lore: It patches kiln walls with its own warm clay.
origin: A Brickit that guarded a kiln through a whole firing.

name: Brickolossus
lore: A fire burns on its shoulders like a kiln. Whole streets are built from its old bricks.
origin: The brickmakers say it carried the first kiln to Ashmere.

name: Clinklet
lore: It clinks when it walks. It eats the cool slag nobody wants.
origin: Crawled out of a slag heap that had cooled for a year.

name: Clinkshell
lore: Sharp slag spikes grow on its shell. Miners leave it alone.
origin: A Clinklet that ate its way through a whole slag heap.

name: Clinkerdome
lore: Its shell is a heap of black glass. When it sleeps it looks like a hill.
origin: Grown on the largest slag heap of Ashmere.

name: Peatlet
lore: It sinks into the bog up to its eyes and waits for rain.
origin: Sprouted from a peat brick left out in the rain.

name: Peatbloom
lore: A ring of pale petals opens around its head when the fen is quiet.
origin: A Peatlet that drank from the black water for a whole season.

name: Peatmonarch
lore: Its petals glow over the dark fen. Lost walkers follow the light home.
origin: Grown in the oldest bog, where the peat is deepest.

name: Gloomgill
lore: It swims in black water and lights its way with its feelers.
origin: Hatched in fen water too dark for the sun to reach.

name: Gloomgillar
lore: Its spines prick anything that reaches into the water.
origin: A Gloomgill that hid in the fen through a long drought.

name: Gloomgillith
lore: Its lights draw small fish close. Fen folk say not to follow them.
origin: Grown in the deepest pool of the dark fen.

name: Fumelet
lore: A curl of smoke with sleepy eyes. It drifts wherever the wind pushes it.
origin: Rose from a chimney on a windless night.

name: Fumewraith
lore: It wraps itself around lamps and dims them to sleep in the dark.
origin: A Fumelet that drifted through every chimney of the works.

name: Fumeregent
lore: A crown of smoke rises from its head. Where it rests, the air turns grey and calm.
origin: Grown in the smoke cloud over the great kilns.

name: Lodekit
lore: It sniffs out ore veins and taps on the rock where miners should dig.
origin: Found in a mine cart, asleep on a pile of ore.

name: Lodebrock
lore: Sparks crackle along its plates when it finds a rich vein.
origin: A Lodekit that found the richest vein in the mine.

name: Lodemarshal
lore: Its tail strikes the rock like a hammer. Whole mines follow its lead.
origin: Grown in the deepest shaft of the Shatterfloor mine.

name: Glowflit
lore: It dances around forge sparks and catches them on its wings.
origin: Hatched from a spark that did not go out.

name: Glowflitter
lore: Its wings glow orange at night. Smiths leave the forge door open for it.
origin: A Glowflit that danced around one forge all winter.

name: Glowflare
lore: When it opens its wings, the night sky over the works lights up like dawn.
origin: Grown in the shower of sparks from the great hammer.

name: Stylet
lore: Its horn is sharp as an engraving needle. It scratches tiny pictures on stones.
origin: Scratched itself out of a spoiled copper plate.

name: Stylox
lore: A spark jumps from its tail tip when it is cross.
origin: A Stylet that engraved a whole wall in one night.

name: Stylaxon
lore: It engraves warnings on cave walls. Only the engravers can read them.
origin: Grown among the lost plates of the old engravers.

name: Coalkid
lore: It nibbles coal and its breath smells of smoke.
origin: Born on a coal ridge in a cold spring.

name: Coalbuck
lore: Its horns glow red at the tips when it charges.
origin: A Coalkid that climbed every coal ridge of Ashmere.

name: Coalpatriarch
lore: Its back holds glowing coal crystals. Herds of Coalkid follow it through the snow.
origin: Grown on the highest ridge, where the coal meets the sky.

name: Glazel
lore: It slides along cooling glass and leaves it smooth and shiny.
origin: Slipped out of a furnace mouth with the first molten glass.

name: Glazelisk
lore: Glass crystals grow along its spine and catch the furnace light.
origin: A Glazel that slept curled around a glass bowl.

name: Glazeldrake
lore: Its body glows like glass just out of the fire. It shapes glass with its breath.
origin: The glassblowers say it taught them their craft.

name: Puffbellow
lore: It puffs up its chest like a bellows and blows the forge fire bright.
origin: Hatched beside a forge bellows on a cold morning.

name: Bellowroc
lore: One beat of its wings stokes a whole furnace. Its crest crackles with sparks.
origin: A Puffbellow that kept the great forge burning through a storm.

name: Lampick
lore: A small light shines above its head. Miners follow it out of the dark.
origin: Lit from a miner's lamp that was left in a tunnel.

name: Lampickard
lore: Its lamp is bright as daylight. It knows every tunnel of the mines.
origin: A Lampick that led a whole shift out of a collapsed tunnel.

name: Charsprout
lore: It sprouts on burnt ground and is the first green after a fire.
origin: Grew from the ashes of a burnt-down barn.

name: Charsylvan
lore: Flames flicker in its leaves but never burn them. Forests regrow around it.
origin: A Charsprout that grew through three fires.

name: Ingotlet
lore: It rolls around in warm ingots and comes out shiny.
origin: Found asleep in a mould between two ingots.

name: Ingotusk
lore: Its tusks are cast metal. It guards the smelter yard at night.
origin: An Ingotlet that slept a whole year in the smelter.

name: Mortarant
lore: It fills cracks in old walls with a paste it makes itself.
origin: Crawled out of a crack in the oldest wall of Ashmere.

name: Mortarmarch
lore: It marches along the walls at night and checks every stone.
origin: A Mortarant that mended a whole town wall.

name: Vaporel
lore: It floats in warm springs and blows steam bubbles.
origin: Bubbled up from a warm spring by the works.

name: Vaporelle
lore: Its fins fan steam over cold workers. Everyone wants it near in winter.
origin: A Vaporel that warmed a frozen spring back to life.

name: Shadeback
lore: Its shell holds the dark of the Shade Rift. Light seems to sink into it.
origin: Crawled out of the Shade Rift when it first opened.

name: Kilnstork
lore: It stands in quench pools and strikes at sparks as if they were fish.
origin: Landed in a quench pool on the night the kilns were first lit.

name: Puffglass
lore: It blows glass bubbles from its mouth and laughs when they pop.
origin: Breathed into shape by a glassblower on a happy day.

name: Flueling
lore: It crackles inside chimney flues and pops out covered in sparks.
origin: Struck to life when lightning hit a chimney.

name: Inkpip
lore: It lives in inkwells and blows little black bubbles when it is happy.
origin: Spilled from an inkwell when a young cartographer sneezed.

name: Inkspool
lore: Its arms draw lines on any paper it touches. Some of them are real roads.
origin: An Inkpip that slept on a map until morning.

name: Inkregent
lore: It can draw a map of a place it has never seen. The guild keeps its drawings under lock.
origin: The cartographers say the first map of Corvane was its shadow.

name: Weirkit
lore: It slides down mill races for fun and climbs back up again.
origin: Washed over a weir in a spring flood and liked it.

name: Weirrunner
lore: It races the current and always wins. Millers set their wheels by it.
origin: A Weirkit that swam every weir of the delta in one day.

name: Weirmarshal
lore: Its tail steers whole rivers. In floods it leads the water away from the towns.
origin: Grown below the great weir where three rivers meet.

name: Diplit
lore: It sits very still on a branch, then drops into the water with a flash.
origin: Hatched in a riverbank burrow during a thunderstorm.

name: Diparrow
lore: Sparks fly off its beak when it dives. Fish freeze in place.
origin: A Diplit that dived a hundred times without missing.

name: Dipmonarch
lore: It dives like a bolt of lightning. The river lights up where it strikes.
origin: Grown on the tallest willow over the delta.

name: Woadlet
lore: Its shell is stained deep blue. It eats woad leaves and leaves blue trails.
origin: Crawled out of a dye vat in the Woadfen.

name: Woadwhorl
lore: The dyers follow it to the best woad fields.
origin: A Woadlet that crossed the whole fen in one summer.

name: Woadcastle
lore: Its shell is big as a hut and blue as the night. Children hide under it in the rain.
origin: Grown in the oldest dye garden of Corvane.

name: Rubrit
lore: Its shell is madder red. It gnaws on the roots dyers want.
origin: Dug up with madder roots in an autumn harvest.

name: Rubricorn
lore: Its twin horns glow warm red. It guards the madder fields.
origin: A Rubrit that ate a whole cart of madder roots.

name: Rubriclad
lore: Its armour is the deepest red in Corvane. The dye guild copies its colour.
origin: Grown under the red mill of Madderby.

name: Nimbub
lore: Its wool holds rain. When it shakes, a small shower falls.
origin: Born from a low cloud that touched the dike.

name: Nimbuck
lore: Cloud puffs grow on its back. Farmers lead it over dry fields.
origin: A Nimbub that grazed in the rain for a whole week.

name: Nimbarch
lore: Where it lies down, a rain cloud gathers and stays until it leaves.
origin: Grown in the rainiest meadow of the delta.

name: Sluicekit
lore: It plugs small leaks in dikes with mud and pebbles.
origin: Found asleep in a sluice gate after a storm.

name: Sluicer
lore: Its flat tail slaps the water to warn of rising floods.
origin: A Sluicekit that held a dike shut through a flood night.

name: Sluicewarden
lore: It opens and shuts the great sluices with its teeth. The delta trusts it.
origin: The dike keepers say it built the first dike.

name: Vanepip
lore: It perches on weather vanes and turns with the wind.
origin: Hatched on the roof of a mill on a windy morning.

name: Vanecrow
lore: Its feathers crackle before a storm. People take in the washing when it calls.
origin: A Vanepip that sat out a thunderstorm on a church spire.

name: Vanecrest
lore: Its crest points where the wind will blow tomorrow. Sailors watch it closely.
origin: Grown on the highest vane of Corvane.

name: Chimelet
lore: It answers every sound with a soft echo. It loves bells.
origin: Rang out of a bell on a still morning and stayed.

name: Chimewell
lore: It sits by still water and repeats the words people said there long ago.
origin: A Chimelet that listened to the Stillwater for a whole year.

name: Chimeward
lore: Its ring of light hums like a bell. Lost voices find their way back through it.
origin: Grown in the mirror water, where every sound comes back.

name: Rushkit
lore: It hides in the tall rushes and only its ears show.
origin: Born in the rushes on a moonless night.

name: Rushprowl
lore: Its striped coat matches the rushes. It moves without bending a stalk.
origin: A Rushkit that hunted in the fen for a whole season.

name: Rushstalker
lore: Its leaf tail sways like a reed. Nothing in the fen sees it coming.
origin: Grown in the darkest corner of the Woadfen.

name: Ripjolt
lore: It swims in fast water and tingles anyone who touches it.
origin: Hatched where lightning struck a river channel.

name: Ripjolter
lore: Sparks run down the spikes on its back when it hunts.
origin: A Ripjolt that swam through a whole thunderstorm.

name: Ripjoltane
lore: It lights up the delta at night. Boatmen steer clear of its glow.
origin: Grown in the fastest channel of the delta.

name: Grindlet
lore: It sits beside millstones and hums along with their turning.
origin: Chipped off a millstone on its first day of work.

name: Grindwheel
lore: A ring of cogs grows around its head. It turns stuck wheels by hand.
origin: A Grindlet that kept a mill turning when the river ran dry.

name: Grindmonolith
lore: It is heavy as a millstone and just as patient. Mills are built around it.
origin: The millers say it was the first millstone of the delta.

name: Morelit
lore: A soft glow shines under its cap. It lights the forest floor at night.
origin: Sprouted on a fallen log after a warm rain.

name: Morelamp
lore: Its spotted cap glows brighter in the rain.
origin: A Morelit that grew in the shade of the oldest willow.

name: Morelord
lore: Its cap is wide as an umbrella. Travellers wait out the rain beneath it.
origin: Grown in a ring of mushrooms that nobody dared to step into.

name: Rookit
lore: It collects shiny buttons and hides them in its nest.
origin: Hatched in a rook tree over a busy market.

name: Rookwarden
lore: It keeps watch over the fields and calls when strangers come.
origin: A Rookit that guarded a field all through the harvest.

name: Skimmit
lore: It walks on water on its long legs and never gets wet.
origin: Hatched on a lily pad in a still canal.

name: Skimmarch
lore: One kick sends it across a whole canal. It races the boats for fun.
origin: A Skimmit that crossed the widest river in Corvane.

name: Prismist
lore: It appears in rain showers when the sun comes out and paints the air in colours.
origin: Born in the first rainbow over Madderby.

name: Prismistral
lore: Its colours stay in the air for an hour after it leaves. Dyers copy them.
origin: A Prismist that followed the rain across the whole delta.

name: Canalet
lore: It nibbles moss off the canal walls and keeps them clean.
origin: Hatched under a canal bridge in Madderby.

name: Canalord
lore: Stone plates grow along its back. It sleeps in the deepest lock.
origin: A Canalet that swam through every canal of the town.

name: Padlet
lore: It carries lily leaves on its back and floats among the real ones.
origin: Grew up on a lily pond, hidden among the leaves.

name: Padlotus
lore: A whole garden grows on its back. Frogs sit on it in the sun.
origin: A Padlet that drifted on the same pond for ten summers.

name: Thrashkin
lore: It stamps on sheaves and the grain falls out. Farmers love it at harvest.
origin: Born on a threshing floor during the harvest feast.

name: Threshox
lore: Its shaggy mane is full of straw. It can thresh a barn in one night.
origin: A Thrashkin that threshed a whole village's harvest.

name: Cartocoil
lore: It curls on map tables and its body draws the coastlines. The guild calls it their oldest member.
origin: Rose out of the ink of the first map the guild ever drew.

name: Belfrit
lore: It hangs in belfries and hears every bell long before it rings.
origin: Woke when the oldest bell of Corvane cracked.

name: Dusktern
lore: It fishes only at dusk, when the water turns dark.
origin: Flew in from the sea on the evening the ferry first crossed.

name: Fiddlit
lore: Its little antlers curl like young fern fronds. It hops up the fern stairs.
origin: Born where the first fern of spring unrolled.

name: Fiddlehorn
lore: Its antlers grow a new curl every spring. Wind sings through them.
origin: A Fiddlit that climbed every step of the fern stairs.

name: Fiddlestag
lore: When it raises its antlers, the ferns of Veydal rise with it.
origin: Grown on the highest fern stair, above the clouds.

name: Gleamgrub
lore: It glows softly in damp grottoes. Its light shows where the moss is thickest.
origin: Hatched in a drop of dew on grotto moss.

name: Gleamworm
lore: It hangs from cave roofs and its spots shine like stars.
origin: A Gleamgrub that lit a grotto all winter.

name: Gleamwyrm
lore: The whole of Mossmere grotto glows when it wakes.
origin: Grown in the deepest chamber of Mossmere.

name: Skerrit
lore: It nests on the rocks by the lighthouse and screams at storms.
origin: Hatched on a skerry the lighthouse beam passes every night.

name: Skerrigale
lore: It glides on sea wind for hours and dives for silver fish.
origin: A Skerrit that followed the lighthouse beam out to sea.

name: Skerrimast
lore: It perches on mastheads and calls ships home before a storm.
origin: Grown on the farthest skerry of the lake.

name: Pinchkin
lore: It pinches toes in the marsh creeks, but only gently.
origin: Crawled out of a creek when the tide ran out.

name: Pinchward
lore: Its claws can snap reeds in half. It guards the creek mouths.
origin: A Pinchkin that held its creek through a spring flood.

name: Pinchcastle
lore: Its shell is wide as a boat. Marsh birds rest on its back.
origin: Grown in the oldest creek of the saltmarsh.

name: Flicklet
lore: It flicks its flame tail and darts between hot stones.
origin: Hatched from an egg left on a warm vent.

name: Flickscale
lore: Its scales shine like embers. It sleeps in the warmest vent.
origin: A Flicklet that basked on the Kindle Vents for a whole year.

name: Flickwyrm
lore: When it breathes out, the vents flare up all at once.
origin: Grown deep under the Kindle Vents, where the stone glows.

name: Brookhop
lore: It sits on stones in the brook and sings when it rains.
origin: Hatched in a mill pond on a rainy morning.

name: Brookbaron
lore: Its song is so deep the pond ripples. The brook frogs follow it.
origin: A Brookhop that sang through a whole summer of rain.

name: Covepup
lore: It plays in the waves of the coves and barks at seagulls.
origin: Washed into a sea cave on a stormy night.

name: Covewarden
lore: It sleeps across cave mouths and keeps the cold sea out.
origin: A Covepup that guarded a cove through a winter of storms.

name: Gloamhog
lore: It snuffles through the undergrowth at dusk and curls up when startled.
origin: Found curled up under a fern at dusk.

name: Gloamquill
lore: Its quills turn dark at night. Owls leave it alone.
origin: A Gloamhog that wandered Gloamwood for a hundred nights.

name: Glimshell
habitat: Lake shallows below the lantern steps
lore: A small light glows on its shell. Fishers row toward it in the fog.
origin: Hatched under the lantern steps, where the lamps reach the water.

name: Glimbastion
habitat: Lake shallows below the lantern steps
lore: Its light reaches across the lake like a second lighthouse.
origin: A Glimshell that kept its light on through the Hush.

name: Lichub
lore: Lichen grows on its fur. It naps on cool rocks all afternoon.
origin: Woke from a lichen-covered stone in a cave.

name: Lichenbear
lore: Whole lichen gardens grow on its back. It moves so slowly that moss catches up.
origin: A Lichub that slept in one cave for seven years.

name: Verdigrub
lore: Its shell is green like old copper. It hums near copper veins.
origin: Crawled out of a copper pipe in Copperfold.

name: Verdigrand
lore: Sparks jump between its horns. Miners use it to find copper.
origin: A Verdigrub that slept in the old copper mine for a year.

name: Peallith
lore: A stone that rings like a bell. Every sound in the ruins comes back from it.
origin: Rang out of the last bell of Bellstone when the tower fell.

name: Fernwhisk
lore: It races through the ferns so fast that only the swaying fronds show where it went.
origin: Born in a gust that ran up the fern slopes.

name: Hearthmote
lore: A spark that hums. It drifts to any hearth that has gone cold and lights it again.
origin: Jumped out of a vent when lightning struck the hot stones.

name: Vesk
habitat: Windy rooftops of the print quarter
lore: It steals proof sheets off the drying lines and brings them back when nobody is looking. Mostly.
origin: Born in a gust that blew a forger's whole print run into the river.

name: Veskara
habitat: Windy rooftops of the print quarter
lore: Its tails sweep chalk lines off the street, so no one can prove where it has been.
origin: A Vesk that outran three print houses and the watch in one night.

name: Veskarion
habitat: Windy rooftops of the print quarter
lore: Three tails, three alibis. The print houses pay it to be seen somewhere else.
origin: The engravers say it was the wind that signed the first false contract.

name: Siltby
habitat: Silted canals under the engravers' bridges
lore: It filters the canal mud and spits out lost rings. It keeps the gold ones.
origin: Hatched in the silt where an engraver dropped his best plate.

name: Siltarra
habitat: Silted canals under the engravers' bridges
lore: Its fins rise like a row of knives when a boat comes too close to its lock.
origin: A Siltby that grew fat on the coins thrown off the bridges for luck.

name: Siltaroth
habitat: Silted canals under the engravers' bridges
lore: It sleeps under the oldest bridge. Some say the bridge is the part of it that shows.
origin: The canal guild swears it was here before the canals were dug.

name: Cindrik
lore: It warms the acid vats with its belly and asks for nothing. That is what worries people.
origin: Hatched from an ember that fell into a bath of etching acid and did not go out.

name: Cindrel
lore: Its crest flares gold when it lies. It has learned to keep its head down.
origin: A Cindrik that kept a chimney burning through a strike and was paid by both sides.

name: Cindravax
lore: One wingbeat dries a whole print run. Forgers bid for its company like it is a seat in court.
origin: The acid works were built around the nest of the first one, and it never forgave them.

name: Nibbet
habitat: Mossy ink cellars, under copper plates
lore: Every quill on its back is a pen nib. It signs things in its sleep, never its own name.
origin: Curled up from a box of nibs a forger buried when the watch knocked.

name: Nibquill
habitat: Mossy ink cellars, under copper plates
lore: It scratches perfect copies of any signature into copper. Banks hire it, then lock it up.
origin: A Nibbet that copied the mayor's hand so well the mayor asked it for advice.

name: Nibravure
habitat: Mossy ink cellars, under copper plates
lore: Its quills hold enough ink to rewrite a city's records overnight. It has done it twice.
origin: The print houses agree on nothing, except that nobody owns a Nibravure. It owns you.

name: Filigrin
lore: It lands on fresh prints and leaves lace patterns that no forger can copy. Forgers hate it.
origin: Hatched under a reading lamp in a room where someone checked banknotes all night.

name: Filigrace
lore: The spots on its wings look like eyes. Witnesses swear it was watching. Courts accept that now.
origin: A Filigrin that slept inside a ledger for a year and woke up knowing every debt.

name: Filigravure
lore: Its wings are etched finer than any banknote. It sells its own dust to the highest bidder.
origin: The old engravers say it flew out of the first plate ever bitten by acid.

name: Mordling
habitat: Mordant baths in the etching works
lore: It bathes in the mordant vats and comes out shinier. The engravers pretend not to notice.
origin: Hatched from a drop of acid that missed the plate.

name: Mordantoad
habitat: Mordant baths in the etching works
lore: Its skin eats through copper. Forgers hire it to age their fake plates.
origin: Its warts grow from every vat it sits in.

name: Mordantyrant
habitat: Mordant baths in the etching works
lore: It owns the biggest vat in Mordant Row and charges rent to everything that falls in.
origin: The etchers' guild once tried to drain its vat. The guild hall is a hole now.

name: Rimekit
lore: It sleeps on frozen stones and wakes up with frost on its whiskers.
origin: Born in the first frost of the moor.

name: Rimelynx
lore: It walks over the moor without leaving a track. The frost closes behind it.
origin: Its fur turns to ice crystals in the long winter.

name: Rimesovereign
lore: Where it lies down, the moor freezes for a mile around.
origin: Moor folk leave it the first cut of peat so it will let spring come.

name: Burrin
lore: It digs under workshops and comes up wherever someone drops a coin.
origin: Born in the dust of an engraver's tool.

name: Burrowgraver
lore: Its horn cuts lines in stone like a graving tool. Its tunnels look like engravings.
origin: Its horn sharpens on every stone it digs through.

name: Burringrand
lore: Whole streets of Quillmarch stand on its tunnels. Nobody tells the landlords.
origin: The engravers sign their best plates with its claw mark.

name: Hoarling
lore: Frost grows on its little antlers like white moss.
origin: Born under a frozen bush on the moor.

name: Hoarstag
lore: Its antlers hold berries frozen in ice all winter.
origin: Its antlers branch with every winter it survives.

name: Hoarmonarch
lore: Its antlers are a frozen garden. Birds live in them all winter.
origin: The moor folk say winter starts when it first calls.

name: Platewig
lore: It hops on the roofs of Platewick and its feathers click like metal.
origin: Hatched from an egg left on a hot copper roof.

name: Platewing
lore: Its wings are thin metal plates that spark when it dives.
origin: Its feathers harden into plates in thunderstorms.

name: Platemarshal
lore: It guards the roofs of Platewick and fines every pigeon that lands.
origin: The city council pays it a salary, which it spends on shiny screws.

name: Smudgel
lore: It leaves a grey smudge on everything it touches, including your paperwork.
origin: Crawled out of a blotted page.

name: Smudgeworm
lore: It eats wet ink. Clerks keep it to erase their mistakes.
origin: Grows longer with every page it smudges.

name: Smudgewyrm
lore: It once erased a whole town from the map. The town is still there, but nobody can find it.
origin: The Smudge Marsh is named after its sleeping place.

name: Corrodent
lore: It chews through locks with its acid teeth. Burglars love it.
origin: Hatched from a cracked acid jar.

name: Corrodile
lore: Its breath is hot and sour. Iron rusts where it yawns.
origin: Its scales harden in the fumes of the acid works.

name: Corrodrake
lore: It melts a path through the city walls whenever it wants to go out.
origin: The acid works were built where it slept.

name: Gelidfin
lore: It swims under the ice of the canals and taps on it when skaters pass.
origin: Born in a frozen bubble.

name: Gelidray
lore: Its fins freeze the water they touch. It skates on its own ice.
origin: Its fins widen every cold winter.

name: Gelidmonarch
lore: When it rests, the canals freeze so hard that carts can cross.
origin: Canal folk call the coldest week of the year its week.

name: Stampet
lore: It stamps its feet on wet paper and leaves a perfect seal.
origin: Born from an official seal dropped on the road.

name: Stamphorn
lore: Every forger in Quillmarch wants its footprint. It charges by the stamp.
origin: Its hooves harden into seals over the years.

name: Stampcolossus
lore: Its steps shake the Stamp Road. Every step leaves a legal seal.
origin: The courts once declared its footprints valid money.

name: Quilmoth
lore: It flutters around print rooms at night and eats the paper dust.
origin: Hatched from a rolled-up proof sheet.

name: Quilmothra
lore: Its wings are printed with tiny letters. Nobody can read them.
origin: Each night a new line appears on its wings.

name: Quilmothane
lore: Its wings show tomorrow's news. Printers pay it in lamp oil to look.
origin: The print houses say it wrote the first newspaper.

name: Vatrat
lore: It swims in the acid vats and comes out bald and happy.
origin: Born in the sludge at the bottom of a vat.

name: Vatreeve
lore: It runs the back alleys of Mordant Row and takes a cut of every deal.
origin: Grew bold after biting a guild master.

name: Vatbaron
lore: Every rat in Quillmarch pays it, and so do some of the judges.
origin: It once sold the same vat to three guilds in one day.

name: Sleetowl
lore: It hoots once before a sleet storm and then hides.
origin: Hatched in a nest of frozen feathers.

name: Sleetcowl
lore: Its feathers are white as snow. It watches the pass for lost travellers.
origin: Grows its cowl in the first snow.

name: Sleetsage
lore: It knows every path through the Rimeglass Pass and tells none of them for free.
origin: Pass guides pay it in dried fish for advice.

name: Copperling
lore: It polishes itself with copper filings until it glows.
origin: Built from leftover copper plates.

name: Copperclad
lore: Its copper body turns green in the rain. It hates rain.
origin: Adds a plate for every engraver it outlives.

name: Copperpatriarch
lore: It holds the oldest plates of Quillmarch in its chest and opens for no one.
origin: The engravers say every true plate was once part of it.

name: Blotkin
lore: It is a living ink blot with a grin. It spoils letters on purpose.
origin: Dropped off a careless clerk's pen.

name: Blotgrimm
lore: It swallows whole ledgers and leaves the debts behind.
origin: Grows darker for every secret it blots out.

name: Drypup
lore: It scratches lines in everything with its claws, like a drypoint needle.
origin: Born in the dust of Drypoint Lane.

name: Dryhound
lore: It runs the lanes at night and its claw marks lead to hidden workshops.
origin: Its claws grow sharper with every scratch.

name: Fizzlet
lore: It fizzes when it is happy. Its leaves sting a little.
origin: Sprouted in a garden watered with acid runoff.

name: Fizzgrove
lore: A small sour forest grows on it. Only the bravest bees go near.
origin: Its flowers grow brighter the more acid it drinks.

name: Glacilet
lore: It coils in ice caves and its scales are as clear as glass.
origin: Born in a cave where the ice never melts.

name: Glacilisk
lore: Its stare freezes water in a cup. Innkeepers in Rimeholt keep it away from the beer.
origin: Its crystals grow every winter it spends in the caves.

name: Pressbug
lore: It lives under the printing presses and pushes the paper straight.
origin: Hatched in the ink tray of a press.

name: Pressbeetle
lore: It can press a whole page by sitting on it. Printers rent it by the hour.
origin: Its shell hardens under the weight of the presses.

name: Canalurk
lore: It waits in dark locks and grabs whatever falls in, including boots.
origin: Born in the dark under a canal bridge.

name: Canalurker
lore: It keeps a collection of lost boots and sells them back.
origin: Its glow grows brighter in the deepest locks.

name: Forgefly
lore: It flies out of the forgers' chimneys and drops sparks on rooftops.
origin: Hatched in the soot of a forger's chimney.

name: Forgeflare
lore: Its sting is red hot. It seals forged letters with a single touch.
origin: Grows brighter for every forgery it seals.

name: Vitriolus
lore: It floats above the deepest acid vat and hums. The vat glows when it is pleased.
origin: Some say it is the oldest drop of acid in Quillmarch.

name: Frostfoil
lore: It draws frost patterns on windows. Each pattern is a forged signature.
origin: Grew on the frozen window of a forger's shop.

name: Gildfinch
lore: It pecks gold dust from the roof tiles and shines brighter after every meal.
origin: Hatched from a gold leaf that a roofer dropped in the wind.

name: Gildwing
lore: Its wings throw golden light on the streets when it flies over Gildcrest.
origin: Grew its gold feathers in the summer sun on the high roofs.

name: Gildaurus
lore: It circles the tallest tower at noon. Its call sounds like a ringing coin.
origin: The oldest Gildwings stay up in the sun until their feathers turn to pure gold.

name: Ledgepup
lore: It sits on the terrace walls and barks at every cloud that passes.
origin: Born from a warm stone at the edge of a terrace.

name: Ledgehound
lore: It guards the narrow ledges and leads lost walkers back to the stairs.
origin: Its back plates grow from the stones it lies on.

name: Ledgewarden
lore: No wall falls while it stands on it. Its golden plates hold the stones together.
origin: The terrace builders say the first wall was built around a sleeping Ledgewarden.

name: Zenkit
lore: It only plays when the sun stands highest and naps through the rest of the day.
origin: Fell out of the noon sky as a bright spot of light.

name: Zenlynx
lore: Its eyes catch the noon light. It can see a beetle from the top of a cliff.
origin: Climbs higher every day, closer to the sun.

name: Zenithar
lore: It leaps from the highest point of the plateau and its shadow never touches the ground.
origin: Only a Zenlynx that has climbed to the highest peak at noon becomes one.

name: Orrebit
lore: It turns slowly in place, like a small planet around a lamp.
origin: Rolled out of a broken brass ball of the Great Orrery.

name: Orrewheel
lore: The rings around it hum with sparks. It knows the time without a clock.
origin: Each night it adds one ring for every star it counts.

name: Orremarch
lore: It moves the stars of the Great Orrery when the keepers are asleep.
origin: The keepers of the Orrery say it was the first to read the sky.

name: Flatskip
lore: It skips over the shallow salt water and leaves rings of light behind.
origin: Born from a sunbeam that hit the Mirror Flats.

name: Flatskimmer
lore: It glides so flat over the water that it looks like its own reflection.
origin: Its fins grew wide from skimming the flats every day.

name: Flatsovereign
lore: When it rests, the Mirror Flats go still and show the whole sky.
origin: Salt pickers leave it the first bowl of the day.

name: Cloudmop
lore: Its wool is so soft that clouds stop to rest on it.
origin: Born under the shadow of a cloud on a sunny meadow.

name: Cloudram
lore: It butts its head against the wind and wins.
origin: Its horns curl tighter every windy season.

name: Cloudbellow
lore: When it calls, the clouds over the meadow gather and give shade.
origin: Shepherds of the meadow follow the oldest Cloudbellow in summer.

name: Haloon
lore: A small ring of light floats over its head. It follows people who are lost.
origin: Rose from the light on the top step of the White Stair.

name: Halonel
lore: Its wings are thin as paper. It lights the stairs at night.
origin: It grew wings the first night it guided a walker home.

name: Halorch
lore: Its halo is as bright as noon. No shadow stays near it.
origin: The stair keepers light their lamps from its glow once a year.

name: Lumoth
lore: It sleeps inside the lamps of the Lantern Span and wakes at dusk.
origin: Flew out of the first lamp lit on the bridge.

name: Lumothra
lore: Its wings glow warm orange. It dances around open flames.
origin: Grows larger the longer the lamps burn.

name: Lumothane
lore: A swarm of light follows it across the bridge every night.
origin: Lamp keepers say one Lumothane can light the whole span.

name: Vinestep
lore: It climbs one stair a day and leaves a small green leaf on each.
origin: Sprouted in a crack of an old step.

name: Vinestair
lore: Its vines hold loose stairs together. Walkers thank it as they pass.
origin: Its roots grew deep into the stone.

name: Vinespire
lore: It stands as tall as a tower. Whole stairways rest in its vines.
origin: Some say the Long Stair was once a single Vinespire.

name: Noonfox
lore: It hunts in the hottest hour, when other Spirlings hide in the shade.
origin: Its fur caught fire in the noon sun and never went out.

name: Noonvixen
lore: Its tail burns like a small sun. It runs along the terraces at full speed.
origin: It gets faster with every summer.

name: Noonregent
lore: When it stands on the Sunfall Terraces, the sun seems to stop.
origin: Only one Noonregent lives on the terraces at a time.

name: Brasshop
habitat: Brass gears of the Great Orrery
lore: It hops between the gears of the Orrery and oils them with its feet.
origin: Built itself from loose brass parts and a spark.

name: Brassjack
habitat: Brass gears of the Great Orrery
lore: Its legs spring like a clock spring. It can jump over a house.
origin: Each jump winds its spring tighter.

name: Brassgrand
habitat: Brass gears of the Great Orrery
lore: It keeps the Great Orrery running. Its horns spark when a gear sticks.
origin: The Orrery keepers made it their guild sign.

name: Plinthlet
lore: It sits still on old stone plinths and pretends to be a statue.
origin: Grew on an empty plinth by the shore.

name: Plinthshell
lore: Waves break on its shell, but it never moves.
origin: Its shell grows a crystal for every storm it outlasts.

name: Plinthcastle
lore: Small Spirlings live in the halls of its shell.
origin: The people of Paleshore built their harbour wall around one.

name: Kitelet
lore: It hangs in the wind like a paper kite and never needs to flap.
origin: Children of Brightledge say it was a kite that cut its string.

name: Kitewhip
lore: Its long tail cracks like a whip and throws sparks.
origin: Storms on the ridge charge its feathers.

name: Kitemonarch
lore: It rides the storm winds over the ridges and calls the lightning down.
origin: The oldest Kitewhips fly into a storm and come out as monarchs.

name: Coffrel
habitat: Treasure vaults under the Gilt Span
lore: It coils around lost coins in the dark and hisses at thieves.
origin: Woke inside a sealed treasure chest.

name: Coffrake
habitat: Treasure vaults under the Gilt Span
lore: Its gem horn glows when gold is near. It guards the vaults.
origin: Each coin it guards adds a scale of gold.

name: Coffrendrake
habitat: Treasure vaults under the Gilt Span
lore: It sleeps on a hoard under the Gilt Span. No one has seen its whole body.
origin: The bank of Gildcrest pays it in gold to keep the vault shut.

name: Rillsnail
lore: It follows the little streams between the terraces and waters the moss.
origin: Born in a drop of rain on a mossy step.

name: Rillshell
lore: Small plants grow on its shell. It carries a garden wherever it goes.
origin: Seeds that fall on its shell sprout the same day.

name: Rillcastle
lore: A whole terrace garden grows on its back. It moves only when it rains.
origin: Gardeners of the terraces plant their best seeds on it.

name: Spanling
lore: It hides under bridges and knocks on the stones to scare walkers.
origin: Grew from the shadow under the first bridge stone.

name: Spanbrute
lore: It holds up sagging bridges with its arms and asks for a toll in bread.
origin: Its arms grew strong from lifting stones.

name: Spanwarden
lore: It carries a whole bridge on its back during floods.
origin: Bridge builders still leave it a loaf on every new bridge.

name: Spumlet
lore: It blows foam bubbles at the waves and laughs when they pop.
origin: Washed up in the foam of a high tide.

name: Spumeclaw
lore: Its claws whip the surf into foam. Sailors hear it before they see it.
origin: Its claws grow with every storm on the shore.

name: Chalkid
lore: It rolls in the chalk dust until it is white from head to hoof.
origin: Born on a white slope in a dust storm.

name: Chalkhorn
lore: It leaps up the chalk cliffs and its horns leave white marks on the rock.
origin: The marks it scratches show the safe way up.

name: Wellet
lore: It lives at the bottom of the deep well and looks up at the stars by day.
origin: Fell into the well with a falling star.

name: Wellwyrm
lore: It rises from the well at midnight. Its scales show the stars of that night.
origin: Once it has counted every star, it leaves the well.

name: Glintwader
lore: It stands still in the salt pans and waits for its food to glint.
origin: Its feathers turned white in the salt wind.

name: Glintheron
lore: At noon it shines so brightly on the flats that it is hard to look at.
origin: Salt pickers follow it to the richest pans.

name: Gildmite
lore: It nibbles on gilded stones and leaves tiny shiny trails.
origin: Crawled out of the gold paint on an old statue.

name: Gildscarab
lore: It rolls a ball of gold dust along the roads. Merchants take it as a good sign.
origin: Its shell hardens into gold over a long summer.

name: Brazlet
lore: It sleeps in old braziers and warms the terrace on cold nights.
origin: Woke when a forgotten brazier was lit again.

name: Brazierbrute
lore: Its stone body glows from inside. It can carry a fire for days.
origin: The terrace people give it charcoal as thanks.

name: Dewfawn
lore: It drinks the morning dew from the grass and leaves a trail of light.
origin: Born in the first light on a dewy meadow.

name: Dewstag
lore: Drops of dew hang on its antlers and shine like small lamps.
origin: Its antlers grow a new branch every spring.

name: Arcfin
lore: It swims in the pools left by storms and gives a small shock when touched.
origin: Born when lightning struck a rain pool.

name: Arcfinnar
lore: Its sail crackles before a storm. Farmers watch it to know the weather.
origin: Grows a larger sail after every storm.

name: Eavekit
lore: It hides under the eaves and glides from roof to roof at dusk.
origin: Born in the shadow of a golden roof.

name: Eaveprowl
lore: It crosses the whole town over the roofs without touching the street.
origin: Its gliding flaps grow wider with every jump.

name: Gildrelic
lore: It stands on the Gilt Span like a golden statue and wakes only to guard the bridge.
origin: Built by the first goldsmiths and left in the sun until it woke.

name: Zenwhirl
lore: It spins high in the sky and is only seen as a spark at noon.
origin: A whirlwind that reached the top of the sky and stayed there.

name: Gnomonk
lore: It sits in the sundial courts and its shadow tells the hour.
origin: The first sundial of Halcyra was carved after its shadow.

name: Gildbloom
lore: Its petals are thin gold. Bees from all over the plateau visit it.
origin: Grew where a goldsmith spilled his gold dust in a garden.

name: Boltnib
lore: It chews the bolts out of dock rails, then sells them back to the dock master.
origin: Born in a crate marked 'spare parts'. Nobody ordered it.

name: Boltgnaw
lore: Its teeth have gone to rust, which only makes the bite worse.
origin: A Boltnib that ate a whole crane and kept the hook as a souvenir.

name: Boltgrimmer
lore: Dock crews leave it a bucket of nails each night. The ones who forget find their pier gone.
origin: The oldest rat of the quay. It remembers who still owes it.

name: Veilmote
habitat: Candle stalls of Tallowmarket at night
lore: It flies to any candle and wears a little mask so the candle cannot tell who it was.
origin: Hatched in a wax drip on the night of a masked ball.

name: Veilmothel
habitat: Candle stalls of Tallowmarket at night
lore: It snuffs out candles mid-sentence. Many deals in Tallowmarket end in the dark.
origin: A Veilmote that learned which candles are lit for secrets.

name: Veilmarquise
habitat: Candle stalls of Tallowmarket at night
lore: Its mask has three faces. It has never shown anyone a fourth.
origin: Said to have been a guest at every masked ball, and never once invited.

name: Tallop
habitat: Warm drains behind the tallow works
lore: It sits in warm drains and smells like a candle shop. It considers this a talent.
origin: Grew from a lump of tallow that fell into the harbour and refused to sink.

name: Tallogg
habitat: Warm drains behind the tallow works
lore: The candles on its head never go out. It has tried, out of boredom.
origin: A Tallop that sat under a chandler's vat for a whole winter.

name: Tallowgrand
habitat: Warm drains behind the tallow works
lore: Tallowmarket weighs its candles against it. The scales have been wrong for years.
origin: The market's oldest stall-keeper swears it was there before the market.

name: Dimlure
habitat: Deep harbour water under the night barge
lore: Its little lamp leads fish into its mouth and drunk sailors into the harbour.
origin: Hatched under the night barge, where the light from the deck falls into the water.

name: Dimlurker
habitat: Deep harbour water under the night barge
lore: Smugglers follow its lamp at night. It decides where they land.
origin: A Dimlure that once led a whole cargo ship onto the rocks, on purpose.

name: Dimluminor
habitat: Deep harbour water under the night barge
lore: Its lamp is brighter than the lighthouse. Ships that trust the wrong light are never seen again.
origin: The barge folk say it bought the harbour's darkness and charges rent for it.

name: Tollpip
lore: It sits on bridge rails and screams until you pay. Nobody knows who gets the money.
origin: Hatched in an empty cash box at the first toll booth of Vellmarch.

name: Tollgull
lore: It charges a fee to cross, a fee to stay, and a fee for asking about the fees.
origin: A Tollpip that learned to count, then learned to count wrong.

name: Tollbaron
lore: Every bridge in Vellmarch pays it. Even the bridges that were torn down.
origin: It once held a whole bridge closed until the House paid. The House paid.

name: Sootkin
lore: It nests in warm chimneys and comes out greyer than it went in.
origin: Hatched from an egg that rolled down a chimney and kept warm in the ashes.

name: Sootrook
lore: Small chimneys grow on its back. It smokes when it is angry, which is always.
origin: A Sootkin that slept on the roof of the smelter for a year.

name: Sootregent
lore: When it lands on a roof, the house below goes quiet and counts its debts.
origin: The chimney sweeps say it decides whose fire goes out next.

name: Flakit
lore: Its shell flakes off in rusty chips. It leaves a trail, which is a poor habit for a thief.
origin: Grew on the anchor of a ship that has not moved in fifty years.

name: Flakeshell
lore: Its claws can cut a chain. Ships wake up drifting and blame each other.
origin: A Flakit that moved into a wreck and kept the captain's cabin.

name: Flakebastion
lore: Its shell is riveted like a ship. Some of the rivets came from ships that are now missing.
origin: The harbour masters list it as a wreck. It has never corrected them.

name: Sprockle
lore: The gear on its back turns when it thinks. It thinks mostly about taking things apart.
origin: Crawled out of a broken crane and took one gear with it.

name: Sprocklen
lore: It sparks when its gear catches. Dock workers use it to light pipes, carefully.
origin: A Sprockle that wound itself up during a thunderstorm.

name: Sprockmaul
lore: Its gear can wind a crane on its own. The crane does not get a say in where the load goes.
origin: It took the old harbour crane apart in one night and built itself a better back.

name: Guiskit
lore: It wears a white face over its own and greets everyone like an old friend.
origin: Born behind a mask stall, the night a stranger paid with a fake coin.

name: Guisvix
lore: It learns your voice in a day and uses it to borrow money from your friends.
origin: A Guiskit that went to a masked ball and came home as somebody else.

name: Guisdame
lore: Half of Larkspur Heights has met it. None of them met the same one.
origin: They say it once sat at the House's table for a year before anyone noticed.

name: Fenglim
lore: Its lamp sings a little tune. If you follow the tune, you hear it again, from behind.
origin: A light that someone lost in the marsh and never came back for.

name: Fenglimmer
lore: It repeats the last words of travellers. The marsh is full of them.
origin: A Fenglim that followed a lost lamplighter until he stopped walking.

name: Fenglowmarsh
lore: Its halo rings like a bell under water. Lastlamp locks its doors when it hears it.
origin: The marsh folk say it is every lamp that was ever put out there, still singing.

name: Splotchet
lore: It squirts ink when scared. The forgers keep it in a jar on the desk.
origin: Hatched in a spilled inkwell that ran into the canal.

name: Splotchling
lore: Its ink fades in a week. Contracts signed with it are very popular with the House.
origin: A Splotchet that was squeezed for ink by three forgers and outlived all of them.

name: Splotcheroth
lore: It can blot out a whole canal. Whatever was in the canal is never found.
origin: The forgers' guild pays it a pension. Nobody asks what for.

name: Snaglet
lore: Its tail ends in a hook. It fishes off the pier and takes your catch too.
origin: Born in a net that two boats both claimed.

name: Snagwhisk
lore: It hooks wallets out of coats so gently that people thank it for the help.
origin: A Snaglet that grew up between two fishing families who both fed it.

name: Snaggrave
lore: Every boat in Hookwick has two owners. It has a hook in both.
origin: The fishers say it settled the oldest feud in town by sinking both boats.

name: Pewnib
lore: Its spines are soft metal. It bends them back into shape every morning, grumbling.
origin: Rolled out of a pewter mould at the smelter, still warm.

name: Pewspine
lore: Its spines ring when struck. Street gangs use it as a doorbell, once.
origin: A Pewnib that slept in a box of spoons and woke up sharper.

name: Pewrampart
lore: It sits on the road and the road goes around it. Carts that do not are melted down.
origin: The smelter's oldest worker says it was poured from the first ingot, and the second.

name: Snoblet
lore: It only eats from silver plates and looks down on everyone, even from the ground.
origin: Hatched on a garden wall in Larkspur Heights and has not come down since.

name: Snobplume
lore: Its plume costs more than your house. It reminds you of this.
origin: A Snoblet that was given a gold collar for being rude to a duke.

name: Snobsovereign
lore: The rich of Larkspur Heights bow to it. It does not bow back, and nobody expects it to.
origin: They say it inherited three houses from owners who were not finished living in them.

name: Tithel
lore: It keeps a coin under its shell for every favour owed. It is very heavy.
origin: Hatched in a tax cellar from an egg nobody declared.

name: Tithshell
lore: It walks into counting houses and sits on the books until the numbers improve.
origin: A Tithel that moved into a ledger box and learned the trade.

name: Tithebastion
lore: Its shell holds the debts of a whole town. The town would like them back.
origin: The counting houses swear it was the first tax collector, and it never retired.

name: Bargit
habitat: Under bridges, on the night barge's mast
lore: It hangs under bridges and clicks. The clicks come back and tell it who is coming.
origin: Born on the night barge, between two passengers who never said a word.

name: Bargwing
habitat: Under bridges, on the night barge's mast
lore: It hears whispers through walls and repeats them to whoever pays in fruit.
origin: A Bargit that rode the night barge a hundred times without a ticket.

name: Bargemourn
habitat: Under bridges, on the night barge's mast
lore: Its cry echoes down the canals. Whoever hears it three times stops taking the barge.
origin: The bargemen say it carries the voices of passengers who paid and never arrived.

name: Sedgel
lore: It hides in reeds and bites ankles. It is sorry about none of them.
origin: Grew from a reed that a thief used to breathe under water.

name: Sedgecoil
lore: It wraps around boat poles. Marsh guides charge extra to unwrap it.
origin: A Sedgel that ate a marsh guide's map and now knows all the paths.

name: Sedgemire
lore: The marsh paths move when it does. Lost travellers are rarely lost by accident.
origin: The Lastlamp folk say it was paid once to hide a body. It kept the job.

name: Smogpup
lore: It wears a little mask against the smoke and barks at anyone the House does not know.
origin: Born in a coal yard of the House, under a sign that says 'no dogs'.

name: Smoglurcher
lore: It follows debtors home and sits outside their door, smoking quietly.
origin: A Smogpup the House sent to collect a debt. It came back with interest.

name: Smogcapo
lore: When it enters a yard, the chimneys go dark one by one. Nobody argues with it twice.
origin: It was the House's most loyal hound, until it found out who really ran the House.

name: Hushbeak
lore: It sits on rooftops and listens. Rumours bought from it are true, mostly.
origin: Hatched under the rumour stall, where secrets are sold by weight.

name: Hushmonger
lore: It sells the same secret to both sides and then a third secret about the sale.
origin: A Hushbeak that once heard the House plan a betrayal, and sold tickets.

name: Moldcap
lore: It grows in wine cellars. The wine tastes better and the owners sleep worse.
origin: Sprouted on a barrel that was hidden from the tax men.

name: Moldmagnate
lore: It owns half the cellars of Vellmarch. It has never paid rent and never been asked to.
origin: A Moldcap that grew over a whole vault and the contracts inside it.

name: Groatfin
lore: Its scales look like coins. People throw it real ones, and it keeps those too.
origin: Hatched in a wishing fountain where nobody's wish came true but its own.

name: Groatgrand
lore: It lives in the richest fountain in town and charges the fountain for the privilege.
origin: A Groatfin that swallowed a purse and liked it.

name: Shivlet
lore: It waits in stairwells, very still. Most people only see it when they are already falling.
origin: Hatched behind a loose stair that nobody ever fixed.

name: Shivreaper
lore: Its claws are thin as letter openers. It opens letters too, and reads them.
origin: A Shivlet that took a job with the House and never told anyone what the job was.

name: Latchet
lore: It stands at gates and wears a mask so you cannot tell if it is smiling. It is not.
origin: Carved from a gatepost of Larkspur Heights and told to keep people out.

name: Latchgrim
lore: It has never let anyone through a gate without a password. It changes the password daily and tells nobody.
origin: A Latchet that guarded one door so long the house behind it fell down.

name: Waxwhisk
lore: Candles grow on its head. It visits wakes and keeps them burning all night.
origin: Born in a chandler's shop on the night the chandler forgot to pay the House.

name: Waxwidow
lore: It has been to more funerals than any priest. Several of them were for its owners.
origin: A Waxwhisk that sat by a coffin for three nights and came away grown.

name: Fauxscript
lore: It can copy any hand. The House's best contracts are written by it, and so are the worst ones.
origin: The forgers say it crawled out of the first fake signature ever made in Vellmarch.

name: Anchorrot
lore: It coils on the harbour floor around an anchor. Ships that drop anchor near it lose both.
origin: The oldest wreck in the harbour was its cradle. The second oldest was its first meal.

name: Knellgrim
habitat: The old bell tower over the quay
lore: It rings once for every debt that is paid and twice for every one that is not.
origin: It hung in the quay's bell tower until the tower forgot who put it there.

name: Mirefane
habitat: The deepest pools of the marsh
lore: Its lamp glows in the deepest pool of the marsh. People who go to check never report back.
origin: Grew from the marsh's oldest secret, which was buried there with a lantern on top.
